_: The jars on the GitHub releases, one row per Minecraft branch (CONTRIBUTING.md, Minecraft versions), newest first. The wiki's download tables (src/data/code/downloads.ts) and the store pages and README read this, and build every link from it. A row has two loaders: neoforge and fabric, or forge and fabric (1.20.1). The tag is <build>-<neoforge> (or <build>-<forge>), the files VineAndBarrel-<build>-<neoforge or forge>.jar and VineAndBarrel-<build>-<fabric>.jar. After a release is up, set its versions here. From each branch's gradle.properties: release_game_versions (minecraft), minecraft_version (build), mod_version (neoforge or forge), fabric_mod_version (fabric); needs: the lower end of neo_version_range (or forge_version_range), the oldest Fabric Loader the jar accepts (fabric_loader_min_version where the branch has it, else fabric_loader_version), fabric_api_version without its +suffix. without: the optional mods of downloads.ts (optional) with no build for that version and loader (left out of the branch's release.yml). curseforge: the file ids of the same jars on CurseForge (curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/vine-and-barrel/files/<id>), for pages on CurseForge itself; left out until the files are up.
